CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users(id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,email text UNIQUE,username text NOT NULL,avatar text,rating integer DEFAULT 1000 NOT NULL,xp integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,level integer DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,intro_id text DEFAULT 'dramatic-look' NOT NULL,created_at timestamptz NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lobbies(id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,code text UNIQUE NOT NULL,host_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),visibility text DEFAULT 'public' NOT NULL,password_hash text,ranked boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,max_players integer DEFAULT 6 NOT NULL,performance_seconds integer DEFAULT 60 NOT NULL,topic_enabled boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,phase text DEFAULT 'LOBBY' NOT NULL,current_performer_id text,phase_ends_at bigint,version integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,created_at timestamptz NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lobby_players(lobby_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES lobbies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,user_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,ready boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,seat integer NOT NULL,connected_at timestamptz NOT NULL,last_seen_at timestamptz NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS lobby_user_unique ON lobby_players(lobby_id,user_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS lobby_seat_idx ON lobby_players(lobby_id,seat)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS matches(id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,lobby_id text REFERENCES lobbies(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,ranked boolean NOT NULL,topic text,started_at timestamptz NOT NULL,finished_at timestamptz)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS performances(id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,match_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES matches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,user_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),position integer NOT NULL,started_at timestamptz,ended_at timestamptz,average_score double precision)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS votes(match_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES matches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,voter_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),performer_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),stars integer NOT NULL CHECK(stars BETWEEN 1 AND 5),created_at timestamptz NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS one_vote_per_performer ON votes(match_id,voter_id,performer_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reactions(id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,match_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES matches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,sender_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),performer_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),kind text NOT NULL,created_at bigint NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS reaction_feed_idx ON reactions(match_id,created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS match_results(match_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES matches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,user_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),place integer NOT NULL,score double precision NOT NULL,rating_before integer NOT NULL,rating_after integer NOT NULL,xp_awarded integer NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS one_result_per_player ON match_results(match_id,user_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS voice_signals(id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,lobby_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES lobbies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,from_user_id text NOT NULL,to_user_id text NOT NULL,type text NOT NULL,payload text NOT NULL,created_at bigint NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS voice_signal_target_idx ON voice_signals(lobby_id,to_user_id,id)
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS intro_id text DEFAULT 'dramatic-look' NOT NULL
